title: Tourist arrival forecasting with game-theoretic social influence weighting and deep learning
abstract: arXiv:2507.03411v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In the era of Industry 5.0, data-driven decision-making has become indispensable for planning in service systems such as tourism. This paper proposes a non-linear hybrid approach for forecasting tourist arrivals to Hong Kong from five major source markets before COVID-19 and to Sanya, China, through the COVID-19 shock. The method integrates multiple sources of Internet big data and employs a cooperative game-theoretic algorithm to identify coalitions of opinion leaders on social media, whose content then receives larger weights. The Empirical Wavelet Transform (EWT), applied causally, manages nonstationary attributes, and a Stacked Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (Stacked BiLSTM) network tuned by Bayesian optimization generates the forecasts. translated_title: 基于博弈论社会影响加权与深度学习的游客到达量预测
translated_abstract: 在工业5.0时代，数据驱动的决策对于旅游等服务系统的规划已变得不可或缺。本文提出了一种非线性混合方法，用于预测新冠疫情前来自五大主要客源市场赴香港的游客到达量，以及穿越新冠疫情冲击期间赴中国三亚的游客到达量。该方法整合了多个互联网大数据来源，并采用合作博弈论算法识别社交媒体上的意见领袖联盟，使其发布的内容获得更大的权重。因果地应用经验小波变换（EWT）来处理非平稳特性，并通过贝叶斯优化调优的堆叠双向长短期记忆网络（Stacked BiLSTM）生成预测结果。我们证明了底层信任加权覆盖博弈的Shapley值具有闭式解，且最大协同效应联盟可以在多项式时间内被精确找到。
tldr: 该论文提出一种融合合作博弈论意见领袖识别（其Shapley值具有闭式解且最大协同联盟可在多项式时间内精确求解）、因果经验小波变换与贝叶斯优化调优的堆叠BiLSTM网络的混合预测方法，实现了对香港和三亚游客到达量的准确预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid approach combining cooperative game-theoretic opinion leader coalition identification (with closed-form Shapley values and polynomial-time exact discovery of maximal synergy coalitions), causal Empirical Wavelet Transform, and Bayesian-optimized Stacked BiLSTM to accurately forecast tourist arrivals to Hong Kong and Sanya.
